Dear Sir/Madam,

I write in my capacity as Obonganwan Marie Erete, Queen Aruk II, the Traditional Ruler of Eniong Abatim in Efik Land, Nigeria, and Founder and Convener of the African Global Queens Summit, to formally invite Her Majesty Queen Modjadji, the Rain Queen of the Balobedu people of Limpopo Province, South Africa, to visit me in the United Kingdom.

The purpose of the visit is to hold high-level talks on collaboration among African queens and traditional rulers towards the unity and progress of Africa. The African Global Queens Summit, which I convened in the United Kingdom in August 2026 with a Masterclass at the University of Oxford, was established to build the capacity of Africa's queens and women cultural leaders and to position them for leadership in the unification and development of the continent.

Her Majesty holds one of Africa's most revered royal offices, a dynasty of female rulers renowned across the continent and beyond. Our talks will focus on:

  • collaboration between African royal houses in support of African unity, peace and development;
  • the preservation and promotion of African royal and cultural heritage;
  • leadership and capacity-building programmes for queens, women and young people; and
  • the role of Her Majesty in the future work of the African Global Queens Summit.

These are cultural and diplomatic discussions and meetings of the kind permitted under the UK Standard Visitor route.

The proposed visit will take place from [arrival date, from 1 December 2026] to on or before [departure date], following which Her Majesty will return to South Africa to resume her royal, ceremonial and community responsibilities. The visit is strictly temporary. Her Majesty has no intention of seeking employment, remaining beyond the authorised period of stay, or accessing public funds in the United Kingdom.

During her stay, Her Majesty will be accommodated at my residence:

Hawkhill Place, Stanton St John, Oxford OX33 1HS

I confirm that I will be responsible for the following throughout her stay in the United Kingdom:

  • Accommodation
  • Meals
  • Local transportation
  • Her general welfare and wellbeing throughout her stay in England

Assurance of Compliance

I respectfully confirm that Her Majesty has substantial and compelling ties to South Africa, including:

  • Her royal office as Queen of the Balobedu, with continuing ceremonial and customary duties.
  • Her permanent residence in South Africa.
  • Family and community obligations requiring her return upon completion of the visit.

These commitments provide strong assurance that she will depart the United Kingdom at the conclusion of her authorised visit.

Neither I nor Her Majesty has any intention of breaching UK immigration laws or visa conditions. Her Majesty understands that the Standard Visitor route does not permit employment, access to public funds, or long-term residence in the United Kingdom.

I respectfully request that UK Visas and Immigration give favourable consideration to this application. I am available to provide any further information or supporting documentation that may assist in its assessment.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours faithfully,

Obonganwan Marie Erete
